records.title: Accurate Sublayer Pruning for Large Language Models by Exploiting Latency and Tunability Information
records.reason: The arXiv abstract describes SPRINT selecting sublayers using latency reduction and tunability information to improve the LLM speed/quality trade-off.

records.title: BAQ: Efficient Bit Allocation Quantization for Large Language Models
records.reason: The arXiv abstract presents sensitivity-guided adaptive bit allocation for LLM quantization, directly reducing model representation cost.

records.title: Mixture of Chapters: Scaling Learnt Memory in Transformers
records.reason: The abstract describes sparse learned memory banks and a chapter router for long-context Transformer use, scaling context to 262K tokens; this is a plausible memory-system branch relevant to long-context inference.

records.title: Two-dimensional early exit optimisation of LLM inference
records.reason: The abstract evaluates two-dimensional early exit for LLM inference and reports 1.4–2.3x speedups, directly targeting inference compute.

records.title: PASER: Post-Training Data Selection for Efficient Pruned Large Language Model Recovery
records.reason: The abstract presents selective post-training data for recovering pruned LLMs, enabling compressed models to regain capability with less recovery data/compute; directly connected to pruning/compression deployment.

records.title: CODA: Rewriting Transformer Blocks as GEMM-Epilogue Programs
records.reason: The abstract targets Transformer forward/backward training workloads and training-kernel fusion; it does not establish an inference/serving efficiency contribution.

records.title: Attention-aware Post-training Quantization without Backpropagation
records.reason: The abstract introduces attention-aware post-training quantization for LLM deployment without backpropagation, directly connected to model quantization and inference efficiency.

records.title: Beyond Per-Token Pricing: A Concurrency-Aware Methodology for LLM Infrastructure Cost Estimation
records.reason: The abstract proposes concurrency-aware infrastructure cost measurement for LLM serving and evaluates throughput/cost under dense and MoE serving; directly related to inference system performance measurement.

records.title: A Hamiltonian-Inspired Local-Operator Ansatz for Slimming Large Language Models
records.reason: The abstract describes a parameter-, arithmetic-, storage- and memory-reducing operator ansatz applied to LLMs, a direct compression/model-efficiency method.

records.title: Attention Needs to Focus: A Unified Perspective on Attention Allocation
records.reason: The abstract proposes Lazy Attention and reports substantial sparse attention in LLM Transformers, a direct attention-computation efficiency connection.

records.title: GMSA: Enhancing Context Compression via Group Merging and Layer Semantic Alignment
records.reason: The abstract describes soft-token context compression for encoder-decoder models and low-latency long-context QA/summarization, directly relevant to inference context/memory cost.

records.title: CURing Large Models: Compression via CUR Decomposition
records.reason: The abstract applies CUR decomposition to compress LLM weights, reducing model size and improving compression runtime.

records.title: Prune-then-Quantize or Quantize-then-Prune? Understanding the Impact of Compression Order in Joint Model Compression
records.reason: The abstract evaluates how pruning/quantization order affects joint compression of language and vision models, directly within model compression.

records.title: Gating is Weighting: Understanding Gated Linear Attention through In-context Learning
records.reason: The abstract analyzes gated linear attention and its efficient recurrent-decoding connection, a plausible attention/inference systems lineage.

records.title: PASS: Pruning Attention Heads with Almost-sure Sparsity Targets
records.reason: The official OpenReview/TMLR abstract describes attention-head pruning with explicit sparsity targets and reports attention speedups; directly relevant to efficient Transformer inference.

records.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading for AI Agents
records.reason: The arXiv abstract reports sparse reading that preserves task quality while reducing token use and wall time substantially, directly targeting agent inference cost.

records.title: Accelerating Error Correction Code Transformers
records.reason: The official arXiv abstract confirms this is a transformer decoder for error-correction codes in communication systems, not LLM inference; its quantization/energy results belong to a separate application.

records.title: Training-free Dropout Sampling for Semantic Token Acceptance in Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The abstract presents dropout sampling for semantic acceptance in speculative decoding and reports decoding speedups, directly relevant to LLM inference.

records.title: CREST: Effectively Compacting a Datastore For Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The abstract compacts the retrieval datastore used by speculative decoding, reducing storage while improving draft acceptance; direct inference memory/latency connection.

records.title: KernelBand: Steering LLM-based Kernel Optimization via Hardware-Aware Multi-Armed Bandits
records.reason: The arXiv abstract targets GPU-kernel optimization for efficient LLM serving using hardware-aware exploration and reports improved kernel performance.
